crossRefs.note: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.
Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called…
They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself…
